## Source: kam193 (6a8580750a7d490d65866e9407c451efa8dbad9a90c35a54b87416c57eef1fea)
In this campaign, specific versions of involved affected packages hide malicious actions. The malicious code is hidden in specific versions of a dependency (is-it-ai), intentionally pinned by specific versions of dependent packages. All package versions were uploaded with malicious intention; the ones without malicious references are clearly intendent only to hide a cover for the rest. When triggered, the malicious action fingerprints the environment and contacts the remote server. If it responds with an URL, it will be downloaded and executed.


---

Category: MALICIOUS - The campaign has clearly malicious intent, like infostealers.


Campaign: 2026-10-is-it-ai


Reasons (based on the campaign):


 - Downloads and executes a remote executable.


 - The malicious code is intentionally included in a dependency of the package


 - targetted-attack


 - action-hidden-in-lib-usage
